author: Raffles, 1822
status: 나그네새 수천 마리 · 여름철새 수십 마리
habitat: 낙엽활엽수림, 잡목림, 인가 부근의 외딴 교목
summary: 중부 이북과 남한에서 비교적 흔히 볼 수 있는 여름철새로, 낙엽활엽수림이나 잡목림에 살며 인가 근처에 홀로 선 큰키나무 꼭대기에 둥지를 틀기도 한다. 번식기에는 암수가 함께 지내다가 이동 시기에는 무리를 이룬다. 5~6월에 한배에 알 4~5개를 낳고, 곤충을 주로 먹는다. 시베리아, 중국 북동부, 일본 등지에서 번식하고 동남아시아에서 겨울을 난다.

art.subject: Ashy Minivet (Pericrocotus divaricatus), adult male as seen in Korean woods from May to September: forehead and front half of the crown white; rear crown and nape black; a short white supercilium above the lores; a black line from the bill base through the eye; ear-coverts white, greyer towards the rear; a thin white line below the eye; chin, throat, neck sides and all underparts white, the flanks faintly grey; back, rump and wing coverts clean ash-grey; flight feathers black with a white bar across their bases; tail black, the outer feathers with long white wedge-shaped tips. Bill black; brown iris; legs black.
art.pose: perched at the very top of a tall tree, side view
art.scene: a lone tall tree at the edge of deciduous broadleaf woodland in Korean summer; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched: white forehead and forecrown, black hindcrown and nape, black eye-stripe, white throat and underparts, ash-grey back, black wings, black bill and legs
adult male in flight seen from below: white body, black tail with long white wedge-shaped tips on the outer feathers, white bar across the black flight feathers
adult female, side view perched: grey crown and nape with white restricted to a narrow forehead band, greyish eye-stripe, paler grey back, white underparts
art.build: Slim, long-tailed songbird, about 20cm, longer and much slimmer than a sparrow, with a small rounded head, upright stance on treetop perches and a long, graduated tail that extends well beyond the wingtips. Bill short, black, slightly hooked. Legs short, black. Flies high in loose flocks with undulating flight, showing a white wing-bar.
avoid: Do not paint any red, orange or yellow; Ashy Minivet is only grey, black and white, unlike other minivets.
Do not give the male a grey crown; his forecrown is white and hindcrown black.
Do not paint a brown back; it is clean ash-grey.
Do not paint it walking on the ground with a wagging tail like a wagtail; it perches in treetops.
